title: Bound exact crossing-repair laws from fixed deterministic linear summaries
statement: The completed P2 continuation proves one exact limitation: on arbitrary cyclic endpoint orderings of N chords, a deterministic fixed linear summary Az over F2 that alone specifies the exact uniform crossing-repair law must have at least N-1 bits. This is a full scoped lemma. The arbitrary asymmetric directed-Eulerian near-linear every-run entire-TV sampler remains unresolved, with no full-contract impossibility. Earlier bidirected near-linear construction and full-class m^(3/2)-polylog comparator retain their exact scopes. Every z is realized by placing one endpoint of each selected chord between x endpoints and all remaining endpoints outside. Rank-nullity then distinguishes required probabilities1 and1/(1+|supp h|) for the same Az. All representation and orbit limitations in the source are essential.

assumptions: Deterministic fixed linear summary only, exact repair distribution, arbitrary endpoint-order universe and no additional state. Random sketches, nonlinear/query-specific structures, approximate conditional distributions and actual fixed-graph orbit restrictions are not ruled out. This is not a general backend lower bound or a full asymmetric Euler-tour impossibility. Repeated marginal/TV and source-cost discussion preserves prior contracts and is not counted as a second new theorem. Complete original prompt/continuation/response/activity available; no ZIP visible. All known/unknown holds persist; no source recovery or scientific rerun.
